headline: Every Bar Points to Toronto
caption:
Three factors, one direction: all of them lean Raptors.

The biggest push is tonight's players. Who's actually suiting up moves our model 4.1 points toward Toronto. Recent point differential adds 3.9 more, and team efficiency nudges in another 0.3. That all sits on top of the baseline, where the average game has the home team by 2.3.

Add it up and our model makes Toronto an 81% pick. Strong, not a lock: Chicago wins this one about 1 time in 5.

Do the Bulls pull it off tonight?
